target_claim: The map c(φ)=|⋃_{v∈V(F)}φ(v)| is a proper coloring of the strong compatibility graph of Hom_p(F,K_n).
source_quote: Indeed, if $\phi$ is connected to $\theta$ in $C_{Hom_{p}(F, \mathcal{K}_n)}$, then $\phi\circ i_F$ is comparable with $\theta$ and $\phi\circ i_F\neq\theta$ which imply $|\bigcup_{v\in V(F)}\phi (v)|\neq |\bigcup_{v\in V(F)}\theta (v)|$. Thus, $c$ is a proper coloring of $\widetilde{C}_{Hom_{p}(F, \mathcal{K}_n)}$.
